free_tier.stated: Preconfigured dedicated servers with free setup, listed monthly: a Core 2 Duo at 2 cores / 2 threads with 4 GB DDR2, a 250 GB SATA disk, 100 Mbit unmetered and 1 usable IPv4 for USD 9.00 a month, and an i7-2600 at 4 cores / 8 threads with 16 GB DDR3, 1 TB SATA, 1 Gbit unmetered and 5 usable IPv4 for USD 25.00. The top of the list is a Dual Xeon E5-2696v3 at 36 cores / 72 threads with 128 GB DDR4 and 2 x 4 TB SSD for USD 199.00, also with free setup and 1 Gbit unmetered.

chaining: A USD 9 whole machine with 5 usable IPv4 addresses on the USD 25 tier is the cheapest place to terminate a set of outbound connections that need distinct source addresses, and it composes with a cheap bulk-storage host for the data it collects.

limits.value: The port speed is the ceiling on the USD 9 machine at 100 Mbit; on every machine from USD 25 up it is 1 Gbit, and the hardware generation binds before the network does.
